articles.title: Tata Trusts Row: Mistry Challenges Removal, Questions Srinivasan's Vote, Raises Governance Issues
articles.description: Fresh controversy has erupted at Tata Trusts after former trustee Mally Mistry challenged his removal from the Sir Dorabji Tata Trust. Mistry has questioned Venu Srinivasan's authority to vote against his reappointment, alleging that Srinivasan's own tenure had ended. He has also sought an inquiry into alleged commissions and conflict of interest issues within the trust. Krishna Gopalan, Business Today, brings you the latest developments, the governance concerns raised by Mistry and the possible implications for the Tata Group. With the upcoming Tata Sons board meeting adding to the developments, all eyes are now on how the dispute unfolds.

articles.title: Putin’s arsenal haunts Ukraine? 700 missiles in stock, 200+ new every month: Can Kyiv defend itself?
articles.description: Russia’s growing missile arsenal is raising fresh concerns for Ukraine as the war continues to strain Kyiv’s air defences. Reports suggest Moscow may have around 700 missiles in reserve while producing more than 200 additional missiles every month. If these estimates are accurate, Russia could sustain repeated waves of strikes against Ukrainian cities, military facilities and critical infrastructure. The figures also raise questions about Ukraine’s ability to intercept incoming attacks as it faces pressure on its supplies of air-defence systems and interceptor missiles. How long can Kyiv keep defending its skies against Putin’s expanding missile capacity?

articles.title: Delhi Chokes As AQI Crosses 400; BJP-AAP Clash As Capital Battles Severe Pollution
articles.description: Delhi's air quality has deteriorated sharply, with the AQI crossing 370 on Wednesday morning and several areas recording readings above 400 in the severe category. Dhaula Kuan, Ghazipur and Sunehri Bagh were among the worst-affected locations, while Noida and Gurugram continued to battle poor air quality. As the national capital struggles to breathe, a political blame game has erupted between Delhi and Punjab. Delhi Environment Minister Majinder Singh Sirsa blamed the Bhagwant Mann government, while the Punjab Chief Minister hit back. BJP and AAP leaders have also sparred over pollution levels and the role of stubble burning, with Diwali approaching and concerns growing over a further deterioration in air quality.

articles.title: Samana Jeep hits Scool Van | ਜੀਪ ਨੇ ਸਕੂਲੀ ਵੈਨ ਨੂੰ ਮਾਰੀ ਸਾਈਡ, 2 ਬੱਚੇ ਜਖ਼ਮੀ | Accident News
articles.description: ਸਮਾਣਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਸੜਕ ਹਾਦਸੇ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਸਕੂਲੀ ਟੈਂਪੂ ਟਰੈਵਲਰ ਦਰੱਖਤ ਨਾਲ ਟਕਰਾ ਗਿਆ। ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਇੱਕ ਜੀਪ ਨੇ ਟਰੈਵਲਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਈਡ ਮਾਰੀ, ਜਿਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਬੇਕਾਬੂ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਟਰੈਵਲਰ ਦਰੱਖਤ ਨਾਲ ਜਾ ਟਕਰਾਇਆ। ਹਾਦਸੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਟਰੈਵਲਰ ਵਿੱਚ 20 ਸਕੂਲੀ ਬੱਚੇ ਸਵਾਰ ਸਨ। ਇਸ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਦੋ ਬੱਚਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਹਾਂ ਵਾਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਡਰਾਈਵਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੱਟਾਂ ਲੱਗੀਆਂ। ਸਾਰੇ ਜ਼ਖ਼ਮੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਲਾਜ ਲਈ ਹਸਪਤਾਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਖ਼ਲ ਕਰਵਾਇਆ ਗਿਆ। A school transport vehicle met with an accident in Samana after a jeep hit it from the side, causing it to go out of control and crash into a tree. There were 20 schoolchildren travelling in the vehicle at the time. Two children and the drivers of both vehicles sustained injuries. All the injured were admitted to hospital for treatment.

articles.title: BJP-Congress Clash Over Foreign Links As Rahul Gandhi Dares PM Modi To Debate
articles.description: A fresh political showdown has erupted between the BJP and Congress over allegations of foreign influence and funding. Rahul Gandhi has challenged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to an open debate, questioning his mandate and accusing him of relying on foreign support. The BJP has hit back, with leaders attacking Rahul Gandhi over alleged dual citizenship and questioning his links with entities associated with George Soros. Union Minister Giriraj Singh has also made allegations concerning Sonia Gandhi’s citizenship and voting record. The exchange adds to the growing confrontation between the two parties over the Special Intensive Revision and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
